column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Compassion” is rendered “mercies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I felt disgust” is rendered “loathe them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The head of your word” is rendered “The sum of Your word.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Officials” is rendered “Princes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “One who brings out much plunder” is rendered “one who finds great spoil.”

Close to the Hebrew; “My cry of entreaty” is rendered “my cry.”
